status: STATICcompositionproxy; source-pose geometric candidate relations only; not active physics, solver truth, or source solution labels

criteria.scope: Unlinked source sliders against ring body outlines at each captured source pose; authored ring and guide links are omitted from these proxy relations.
criteria.exactGeometry: Polygon and box colliders use native serialized paths/vertices, including holes; circles use a 128-segment Shapely polygon approximation.
criteria.pull_axis_crosses_ring: Finite pull axis extends half the native Pull length plus half-width on both ends; strong when it intersects the exact ring solid's convex hull at source pose.
criteria.pull_hull_contains_ring_center: Strong enclosure/interleaving candidate when the convex hull of exact Pull solid outlines covers the ring center.
criteria.pull_near_ring: Weak proximity candidate when exact solid-outline gap <= 0.75 * combined source widths and finite pull-axis to ring-convex-hull gap <= one combined source width; proximity is not contact/blocking proof.
criteria.authoredEdges: Only unlinked pairs are reported. The graph is composition-only and does not replace or infer native pin/guide edges.

evidence.nativeColliderGeometry: serialized exact PolygonCollider2D/BoxCollider2D outlines and holes; circles are polygonized at 32 segments per quadrant
